confirmed.statement: S1 explicitly reports 100 recruited participants and 81 participants included in the final analysis.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4, section 4, opening paragraph; p. 13, Appendix A.1.

confirmed.statement: Both S1 arms contain the same 81 analyzed people: each completed four treatment tasks and two control tasks. The two arm counts must not be added to obtain 162 people.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4, section 4 and Figures 1-2; p. 24, Table 9 caption.

confirmed.statement: Table 9 sums to 324 treatment task observations and 162 control task observations, calculated from its eight rows; these equal 81 times four and 81 times two, respectively, and are not additional participants.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 24, Table 9, Control/Treatment columns and caption; totals calculated from the printed counts.

confirmed.statement: S1 used two randomized within-person task blocks, and selected tasks were randomly allocated to treatment and control. Figure 1 shows block randomization but no allocation or attrition counts.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4, section 4 and Figure 1, including the randomization bracket/die; p. 24, Table 9 caption.

confirmed.statement: S1 excluded people who never edited any LLM draft or did not complete the entire study. The recruited-to-analyzed difference is 19 people (100 minus 81); exclusion-reason counts and timing relative to randomization are not reported.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 13, Appendix A.1, recruitment and exclusion paragraph; p. 4, section 4.

confirmed.statement: The source gives no exact S1 randomization-stage total or block-order sequence counts, supporting null n_randomized at study and arm levels rather than treating the 100 recruits as a confirmed randomized total.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4, section 4 and Figure 1; p. 13, Appendix A.1; p. 24, Table 9.

confirmed.statement: S1 recruited English-fluent Prolific users and limited participation to one session per person. The lower-than-preregistered recruitment target was attributed to completion time and the payment budget, explicitly not study results.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 13, Appendix A.1 and footnote 13.

confirmed.statement: Ancillary analyses use smaller subsets: Appendix B.4 omits unspecified demographics, and B.6 excludes three respondents who preferred unedited AI text. These are not further exclusions from the main H1/H2 analyses, which explicitly consider the full dataset.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 17, Appendix B.4 opening paragraph and footnote 15; p. 19, Appendix B.6; p. 5, footnote 12.

confirmed.statement: S2 had 102 survey completers and 88 attention-check passers, supporting 88 analyzed people at both study and survey-arm levels. The difference is 14 attention-check failures (102 minus 88).
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 23, Appendix C, completion/attention-check paragraph and Figure 14 axis identifying attention-check-passing participants.

confirmed.statement: S2 randomized scenario presentation order, with no AI-assistance arm; its exact randomization-stage total is not reported, supporting null n_randomized. The survey sample is not needed to satisfy criterion 2.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 22-23, Appendix C, survey procedure and participant paragraph.

confirmed.statement: S2 participants were explicitly prohibited from also completing S1, supporting disjoint samples within this paper. No reuse of another paper's participant sample is disclosed; cross-paper overlap remains unknown.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 23, Appendix C, participant paragraph; p. 13, Appendix A.1; full-document review, including Appendices A-D.

confirmed.statement: S1 alone satisfies the threshold of at least 50 analyzed people: its randomized within-person comparison includes 81 unique writers. Output-pair comparisons in the diversity analysis do not inflate this participant count.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4, section 4 and Figure 1; p. 7, Figure 6 caption; p. 13, Appendix A.1; p. 24, Table 9 caption.

summary: The participant coding is supported: S1 analyzed 81 unique people in both within-person conditions, and S2 retained 88 of 102 survey completers in a separate sample. Criterion 2 holds on S1 alone; exact randomization-stage totals and the breakdown of S1's 19 exclusions remain unreported.
